statement: AMD attributes Q2 2026 data-center strength to strong demand for EPYC processors and Instinct MI350 Series GPUs.
why: Naming a specific shipping accelerator family as the demand driver shows the newest part is already in volume deployment, not just sampling.

impact.mechanism: Volume demand for the current-generation Instinct family signals accelerator design wins converting to revenue.

evidence.excerpt: strong demand for our AMD EPYC processors and AMD Instinct MI350 Series GPUs
